holdout.news_source: news_days.csv (built from ONYX TRADING/research/data/ff_usd_red_raw.txt: FF red USD CPI / NFP / FOMC)
holdout.coverage_tool_note: homebase data_coverage 2026-10-01T01:35Z (last 30 sessions): NQ complete 25, partial 4 (2026-09-11, 09-22, 09-23, 09-25), missing 1 (2026-09-07 = US holiday)

scoring.rolling_starts: every session with a full horizon (5 sessions eval, 60 funded) on the holdout calendar (weekday archive sessions)
scoring.controls: day-matched random runs re-run on the same 2025+ days; pool = the same exit-profile pool as in-sample, eval seed crc32(cid)%100000, funded seed crc32('fund|'+cid)
